etymologies.etymologyHTML: From yuck +‎ -y. Compare Old English ġyċċiġ (“putrid”).

definitions.definition: (colloquial, often childish) Of something highly offensive; causing aversion or disgust.

quote.citation: 2007, "Queensland to drink waste water", BBC Online:
quote.text: "Don't rule out desalination because it is expensive, or recycling because it sounds yucky, or building a dam," Mr Turnbull told Australian media."
